legacy_route.mechanism: TableAlias accessors (t.GetNullableDecimal("[1]")) leave ColumnName unset, so the legacy path emits bare identifiers.

alias_spelling.rule: A projected member whose name equals its source column case-insensitively is emitted bare; a member whose name differs is emitted as '<column> as [<Member>]' (ColumnName drives the rename alias in SqlSourceRenderer.MakeColumn).
alias_spelling.scalar_member: A scalar projection has no invented member alias.

typed_column_route.mechanism: SqlFunctions.Column<T>(source, name) binds the TableAlias source and sets ColumnName, so the cell is aliased to its member.

observed_legacy.trigger: Pivot over a derived query with modifiers

planned_typed.trigger: Duplicate PIVOT values (names the offending value)
A consumed grouping member is also an aggregate/FOR column
Missing or conflicting UNPIVOT role identifiers
A marker is used where no TableAlias PIVOT/UNPIVOT source is bound (D-03 fail-closed)

null_count_expectations.non_nullable_against_null: A non-nullable cell type against a SQL NULL is an ownership defect, not silently coerced
null_count_expectations.nullable_aggregate: A nullable aggregate member materializes null without throwing
null_count_expectations.sum_missing_cell: NULL (South has no quarter 2 row: the [2] cell materializes NULL)
null_count_expectations.unpivot_null_cell: A NULL source cell does not produce an output row; SQL Server UNPIVOT excludes NULL source cells

oracle.legacy_pivot_sql:
select category, [1], [2]
 from sales pivot (sum(margin) for quarter in ([1], [2])) as [t1]
oracle.legacy_unpivot_sql:
select category, qtr, val
 from quarterly unpivot ([val] for [qtr] in ([q1], [q2])) as [t1]
oracle.typed_column_pivot_sql:
select category, [1] as [Q1], [2] as [Q2]
 from sales pivot (sum(margin) for quarter in ([1], [2])) as [t1]
oracle.typed_column_unpivot_sql:
select category, qtr as [Quarter], val as [Measure]
 from quarterly unpivot ([val] for [qtr] in ([q1], [q2])) as [t1]

pivot_value_order.duplicate_values: Duplicate values are a fail-closed guard naming the offending value (D-04).
pivot_value_order.empty_value_projection: An empty value projection is a fail-closed guard (D-04).
pivot_value_order.rule: The IN (...) list follows the projection order (NewExpression argument / MemberInit binding order); no re-sorting, no de-duplication re-order.

provider_matrix.rule: SQL Server-only capability inherited from the existing PIVOT AST/renderer; no new capability flag. Other providers reject both typed operators.

amended.purpose: Freeze the shared oracle/fixture contract consumed by the typed PIVOT/UNPIVOT units (D-03 markers, D-04 provider overloads, D-05 integration), before any production implementation exists. Test-only data: no production abstraction.
amended.task: T232 (#232) SQL Server typed PIVOT/UNPIVOT projection

unpivot_roles.rule: One identifier per role; repeated consistent references reuse a role, conflicting identifiers fail (D-04).
unpivot_roles.zero_columns: Zero UNPIVOT columns is a fail-closed guard (D-04).

value: A NULL source cell does not produce an output row; SQL Server UNPIVOT excludes NULL source cells
